name: Thick Caps
text: Your front-rank units +15% HP.

name: Fruiting Season
text: Economy buildings +12 gold a round.

name: Rot Ward
text: Your Heartcap takes 15% less damage from each round you lose, before the round's cap.

name: Quick Roots
text: Your melee units move 25% faster until their first attack in each clash.

name: Fresh Spores
text: A building planted this planning phase fields 1 more unit in its first clash.

name: Hardy Spores
text: Your units +8% HP.

name: Root Stipend
text: Your Heartcap's stipend +24 gold a round.

name: Deep Cellars
text: Interest cap +10: each round can pay up to 10 more gold of interest.

name: Spore Tithe
text: +4 gold each time your units merge.

name: Forward Spores
text: As each clash starts, a spore cloud lands on the middle of the enemy's front rank in each lane: 10 damage a second for 4 s, within 1.5 tiles.

name: Knitting Circle
text: Merging takes 50% less time, and units can merge from 0.5 tiles farther apart.

name: Second Flush
text: Selling a building that has fielded refunds 80%, not 60%.

name: Mycelial Web
text: Your colony gains 1 plot.

name: Mending Moss
text: Each round you win, your Heartcap regains 100 HP, up to its max.

name: Bloom Vigor
text: Bloomed and Elder units deal +15% damage.

name: Mycorrhizal Link
text: Your combos also link buildings that touch only at a corner.

name: Spore Cloud
text: Your units burst as they die: 10 Crush damage to enemy units within 1.0 tile.

name: Elder's Patience
text: Elders +25% HP; out of combat they heal 2% of their HP every second.

name: Sporestorm Sigil
text: From the storm's first round, your commander power is 50% stronger: Spore Burst 90 → 135 damage, Rhizome Tithe 2 → 3 gold a supply, Puppet Bloom's reach 3 → 4.5 tiles.

name: Rot-Eater
text: +1 gold for each enemy unit killed in a clash, from the storm's first round.

name: Martyr's Bloom
text: When the last unit of one of your squads dies, it bursts there: 60 Crush damage to enemy units within 2.0 tiles, once a squad each clash.
